summary: The ui-source revision the set admin is built and tested against: the overlay is ui-source at this revision with this folder's src/, tests/ and docs/ laid over it, and ui-builder's package build builds the same (standards simai.component-set 1.0.0 and simai.component-package 1.1.1). It is a candidate, not yet a released pair: simai/ui-source integration/pair-next-19 4c39ecc20 (SIMAI Framework group build 17, with the admin shell parts AS-1..AS-4, AN-1, AN-2, ASR-1, ASR-2), which registers the set's names and carries simai.admin-navigation-port 1.2.0. The same commit is framework.source_revision in set.json; the pin moves to the released pair's source when that pair is cut.
